approval.rationale: EntryVALID1103 and actual shared-source/consumer design case support bounded arithmetic correction and fixed13; worker scope challenge agrees.

limitations: Forward arithmetic/precision correction only, within JavaScript floating-point tolerance. No repair/reset of damaged persisted item or slot counters, old rounded snapshots/archives or previously emitted reports; no historical re-fold, migration/generation marker, automatic replay/idempotency, timestamp/lateness or reward/currency/model-policy choice. Valid future timestamps remain an ingestion-integrity residual; existing caller/config validation is not a customer lateness policy. Full W23/F18 and W22/W24/W30 recovery, trustworthy measurement/customer/deployed SLO/release acceptance remain open. More precise JSON can reach existing byte budgets earlier; capacity guards must remain enforced. Preserve deterministic core, gamma0 and current priors/root-zero/clamps; human prose may round only for presentation. No external/cloud/resource/credential/customer-data/deploy/commit/push/cleanup authority.
